tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The only surface; nothing sits in a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Name, headings, row titles, lead paragraphs and running prose on paper. 16.4:1 on paper.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Supporting text: row descriptions, bullet lists, table values, footer. 8.4:1 on paper.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Small details only: dates, tags, captions, labels, inactive nav and filters. 4.75:1 on paper, so it passes at 14px.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px rules between rows and around screenshots. Decorative, never used for text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marker highlight behind a few words at most. Ink on it is 15.3:1. Never a fill or a button.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Behind screenshots inside their 1px line frame.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name, once per page. 38px on phones.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I build the language infrastructure behind products.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of every page, in ink. 22px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, sentence case, italic so they never read as a lead. 22px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: A terminology system built for people and AI
styles.usage: Row titles: projects, packages, list items. 19px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every entry has an internal and an external name.
styles.usage: All reading text: prose, descriptions, lists, table values. Bold (600) only for a short lead-in.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, tags, captions, table labels. Always muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between list items; between filter links vertically.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Caption above or below an image; footer line gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of steps and table rows; photo grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between filter links; under section headings; call-out indent.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of an opened row.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between the nav and a page's content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above each section heading and above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: images, rows, tables. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The expand toggle only.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the single reading column.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Minimum side padding at every width.

tokens.name: toggle-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the expand toggle.

tokens.name: text-inset
tokens.usage: Right padding on row descriptions so text never runs under the toggle.
